steps.code:
# Let's fetch all habit tracking notes by paginating through search results
all_notes = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.simple_note.search_notes(
        access_token=login_result['access_token'],
        tags=['habit-tracker'],
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=20
    )
    all_notes.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

print(f"Total notes fetched: {len(all_notes)}")
# Print first few to inspect
for n in all_notes[:3]:
    print(n['title'], n['note_id'])

steps.code:
# Fetch content for all habit tracking notes and extract posture status
notes_data = []
for n in all_notes:
    detail = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=n['note_id'], access_token=login_result['access_token'])
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
    date_str = detail['title'].replace('Habit Tracking Log for ', '')
    # Parse posture line
    posture = None
    for line in detail['content'].split('\n'):
        if line.startswith('practiced_good_posture:'):
            posture = line.split(':')[1].strip()
            break
    notes_data.append({'date': date_str, 'posture': posture})

# Sort by date
notes_data.sort(key=lambda x: x['date'])
print("Sorted notes:")
for nd in notes_data:
    print(nd['date'], nd['posture'])
